svg.text: Each feature is one simple calculation that turns raw claims into a fraud signal

g.text: Worked example: PRV-1042 on 4 Mar 2026, plus the CLM-10442 / CLM-10457 duplicate pair

svg.text: All features are plain Python / pandas calculations: no AI, fully reproducible and auditable. Thresholds (±1 day, 5%, 12 h), CPT minutes and score weights are starting assumptions to tune.
Illustrative synthetic data, consistent with the other slides. The duplicate pair scores 60 base + 4 = 64 (Medium) via the same formula family.
